B_bounded_diagnostics.observed: the diagnostics panel renders one line built from closed fields: 'Desktop 0.1.0 · Fixture transcript · generation 1 · publication 2 · error none · commands 0'. No path, URL, credential, payload or free text is present.
B_bounded_diagnostics.layout_note: at the restored 1275x832 window the inspector footer can be clipped below the visible client area; maximizing the window made the same bounded line visible. This is a presentation observation, not a leak claim.

C_fixture_mode_errors.observed: fixture parse/load failures end with the static no-fallback line and do not fall back to Runtime or synthesize data; the process exits 0 and reports the unobserved shutdown outcomes explicitly.

D_ring_capacity_sequence_gap.observed: covered by existing bounded tests: the diagnostics ring sequence exhaustion test, and the publication test pub3_diagnostic_loss_is_explicit_bounded_and_independent_of_canonical_state; six diagnostic publication tests and seven redaction tests pass in this branch.
D_ring_capacity_sequence_gap.native_note: filling the 1,024-event ring from the GUI is not reachable with the current fixture, so capacity/gap behaviour remains unit evidence, not a native observation.

E_secret_and_path_non_exposure.observed: no secret, token, Bearer marker, URL, drive/UNC path or signed locator appeared in any captured stderr or in the debug trace. The trace had 262 COS_FIXTURE_TRACE lines, maximum 314 bytes per line, and contained only fixture ids, counters and booleans. The fixture client journal was 708 bytes / 3 events (fixture-trace.jsonl) and contained only ids, counters and lifecycle categories.
E_secret_and_path_non_exposure.limit: the debug trace does not include user-supplied free text, so the stateful redaction fallback's secret forms are covered by its seven unit tests rather than by a native secret injection.

F_crash_or_abnormal_exit.observed: NOT_RUN. No safe isolated crash path exists in this build; the directive forbids Windows Error Reporting, registry and security changes, and an intentional crash was not forced. Startup/error paths are not substituted for crash evidence.

G_state_and_exit_after_error.observed: after a fixture failure the application quits without a window and reports unobserved shutdown/preferences outcomes; the second instance leaves the incumbent untouched; the endpoint-configured close confirmed 'observation shutdown not applicable' and 'preferences save confirmed'.
